mapper.select: SELECT t.deposit_id AS deposit_id, d.deposit_no AS deposit_no, t.direction AS direction, t.amount AS amount, t.method AS method, (t.occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai')::date AS occurred_at FROM deposit_txn t JOIN deposit d ON d.id = t.deposit_id WHERE t.method = '现金' AND t.direction IN ('I', 'O') ORDER BY t.occurred_at, t.deposit_id

WITH m AS ( SELECT t.deposit_id, string_agg(DISTINCT t.method, ',') FILTER (WHERE t.direction = 'I' AND t.method IS NOT NULL) AS im, string_agg(DISTINCT t.method, ',') FILTER (WHERE t.direction = 'O' AND t.method IS NOT NULL) AS om FROM deposit_txn t GROUP BY t.deposit_id ) SELECT m.deposit_id AS deposit_id, d.deposit_no AS deposit_no, m.im AS collect_methods, m.om AS refund_methods FROM m JOIN deposit d ON d.id = m.deposit_id WHERE m.om IS NOT NULL AND m.im IS NOT NULL AND NOT (string_to_array(m.om, ',') <@ string_to_array(m.im, ',')) ORDER BY m.deposit_id
